quests.title: Windrise, Windfall

dialogue.t: If our winery's business remains closed for any longer, how will I face Master Diluc...
Traveler, if you meet Master Diluc, could you tell him about this?
It just won't do, the way he just leaves the winery to its own devices all the time.
Have you cleared the merchant roads out?
That's great. Our winery's business can gradually resume now.
Honestly, I should have reported this matter to Master Diluc...
But he's upped and disappeared. I've searched high and low for him all over the winery, but no one knows where he's gone.
Adelinde said something like "Master Diluc has gone to attend to a personal matter," but refused to say anything more. She didn't even look worried.
*sigh* Forget it. Once he's back, I will have a good talk with him...

quests.description: The recent storms have been affecting business at Dawn Winery, so Elzer is trying his best to come up with ideas to get things back in order…
